detail.longDescription: I've been automating small business tasks for over a decade. First, for a small law firm I worked for, and then for my own freelance business. And I can confidently say if you're looking for one tool that does it all, the answer is Zapier. It connects every app you could possibly use, works across every function of your business, and scales from a free plan to enterprise-grade workflows without requiring you to switch tools as you grow.
